lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （美心跟良介在學校）
lines.simplified: （美心跟良介在学校）
lines.pinyin: （Měixīn gēn Liángjiè zài xuéxiào）
lines.english: (Meixin and Ryosuke are at school.)

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 你怎麼了？為什麼不去吃午飯？
lines.simplified: 你怎么了？为什么不去吃午饭？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme le? Wèishénme bú qù chī wǔfàn?
lines.english: What's wrong? Why aren't you going to eat lunch?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 今天早上起來的時候，覺得背很疼，我想休息一下。
lines.simplified: 今天早上起来的时候，觉得背很疼，我想休息一下。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān zǎoshang qǐlái de shíhou, juéde bèi hěn téng, wǒ xiǎng xiūxi yíxià.
lines.english: When I got up this morning, my back hurt a lot. I want to rest for a while.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 要是明天還是很疼，最好去看醫生或是去藥房買藥。
lines.simplified: 要是明天还是很疼，最好去看医生或是去药房买药。
lines.pinyin: Yàoshi míngtiān háishì hěn téng, zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng huòshì qù yàofáng mǎi yào.
lines.english: If it still hurts tomorrow, you'd better see a doctor or buy medicine at the pharmacy.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 謝謝妳。對了！我最近在網路上認識了一個女生，她不但很溫柔，也很客氣。我每天都給她打電話，我們聊得很愉快。
lines.simplified: 谢谢妳。对了！我最近在网路上认识了一个女生，她不但很温柔，也很客气。我每天都给她打电话，我们聊得很愉快。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ. Duì le! Wǒ zuìjìn zài wǎnglù shàng rènshi le yí ge nǚshēng, tā búdàn hěn wēnróu, yě hěn kèqi. Wǒ měi tiān dōu gěi tā dǎ diànhuà, wǒmen liáo de hěn yúkuài.
lines.english: Thank you. By the way, I recently met a girl online. She is not only gentle but also polite. I call her every day, and we have pleasant chats.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 你們認識多久了？
lines.simplified: 你们认识多久了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen rènshi duō jiǔ le?
lines.english: How long have you known each other?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 差不多一個月了。
lines.simplified: 差不多一个月了。
lines.pinyin: Chàbuduō yí ge yuè le.
lines.english: About a month.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 見過面了嗎？
lines.simplified: 见过面了吗？
lines.pinyin: Jiàn guò miàn le ma?
lines.english: Have you met in person?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 還沒，她說她不好意思跟我見面，所以我不知道怎麼辦。
lines.simplified: 还没，她说她不好意思跟我见面，所以我不知道怎么办。
lines.pinyin: Hái méi, tā shuō tā bù hǎoyìsi gēn wǒ jiànmiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
lines.english: Not yet. She says she feels embarrassed to meet me, so I don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 也許她覺得一個人跟你見面不安全。這個禮拜六學校有舞會，你要不要請她跟她朋友一起來參加？
lines.simplified: 也许她觉得一个人跟你见面不安全。这个礼拜六学校有舞会，你要不要请她跟她朋友一起来参加？
lines.pinyin: Yěxǔ tā juéde yí ge rén gēn nǐ jiànmiàn bù ānquán. Zhège lǐbàiliù xuéxiào yǒu wǔhuì, nǐ yào bu yào qǐng tā gēn tā péngyou yìqǐ lái cānjiā?
lines.english: Perhaps she doesn't feel safe meeting you alone. There is a dance party at school this Saturday. Would you like to invite her and her friends to come?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這個辦法不錯，妳以前也有這樣的經驗嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个办法不错，妳以前也有这样的经验吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ búcuò, nǐ yǐqián yě yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
lines.english: That's a good idea. Have you had an experience like that before?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 當然有啊！以前有一個男生要跟我約會，我也很害怕，不敢自己跟他見面。
lines.simplified: 当然有啊！以前有一个男生要跟我约会，我也很害怕，不敢自己跟他见面。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán yǒu a! Yǐqián yǒu yí ge nánshēng yào gēn wǒ yuēhuì, wǒ yě hěn hàipà, bù gǎn zìjǐ gēn tā jiànmiàn.
lines.english: Of course I have! Once a boy wanted to go on a date with me. I was scared too and didn't dare meet him by myself.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 後來呢？
lines.simplified: 后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
lines.english: And then?

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 那個時候我剛好要跟同學去動物園玩，我就約他一起去。那天大家在動物園裡看看動物、開開玩笑，後來我就敢一個人跟他約會了。
lines.simplified: 那个时候我刚好要跟同学去动物园玩，我就约他一起去。那天大家在动物园里看看动物、开开玩笑，后来我就敢一个人跟他约会了。
lines.pinyin: Nàge shíhou wǒ gānghǎo yào gēn tóngxué qù dòngwùyuán wán, wǒ jiù yuē tā yìqǐ qù. Nà tiān dàjiā zài dòngwùyuán lǐ kànkan dòngwù, kāikai wánxiào, hòulái wǒ jiù gǎn yí ge rén gēn tā yuēhuì le.
lines.english: At that time I happened to be going to the zoo with classmates, so I asked him to come along. That day we looked at the animals and joked around at the zoo, and after that I dared to go on a date with him alone.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 聽妳說完了以後，我想我知道應該怎麼做了。
lines.simplified: 听妳说完了以后，我想我知道应该怎么做了。
lines.pinyin: Tīng nǐ shuō wán le yǐhòu, wǒ xiǎng wǒ zhīdào yīnggāi zěnme zuò le.
lines.english: After hearing you out, I think I know what I should do.

lines.speaker: 美心
lines.traditional: 現在你的背好一點兒了嗎？
lines.simplified: 现在你的背好一点儿了吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài nǐ de bèi hǎo yìdiǎnr le ma?
lines.english: Is your back a little better now?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: （摸摸自己的背）好像不疼了。
lines.simplified: （摸摸自己的背）好像不疼了。
lines.pinyin: （Mōmo zìjǐ de bèi）hǎoxiàng bù téng le.
lines.english: (Touches his own back.) It seems it doesn't hurt anymore.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （兩人都笑了）
lines.simplified: （两人都笑了）
lines.pinyin: （Liǎng rén dōu xiào le）
lines.english: (Both of them laugh.)

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Verb + 一下: a quick action
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Ask someone to do something briefly, or make an action feel small and easy.
grammarPages.explanation: 「V一下」表示動作持續的時間很短，或動作的量不多。常用在請求、客氣地請人幫忙，或把動作說得輕鬆一點。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 一下 (+ Object)

text.traditional: 他去一下洗手間，馬上回來。
text.simplified: 他去一下洗手间，马上回来。
text.pinyin: Tā qù yíxià xǐshǒujiān, mǎshàng huílái.
text.english: He stepped into the restroom for a moment and will be right back.

text.traditional: 你能介紹一下你自己嗎？
text.simplified: 你能介绍一下你自己吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ néng jièshào yíxià nǐ zìjǐ ma?
text.english: Could you introduce yourself a little?

text.traditional: 我去旁邊的商店買麵包，你可以等一下嗎？
text.simplified: 我去旁边的商店买面包，你可以等一下吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ qù pángbiān de shāngdiàn mǎi miànbāo, nǐ kěyǐ děng yíxià ma?
text.english: I am going to the shop next door for bread; could you wait a moment?

words.meaning: I go to the shop next door

items.question: Is 一下 the same as 一次?
items.answer: No. 「一下」強調時間短、動作輕鬆；「一次」數的是次數，例如「看一次」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他去一次洗手間，馬上回來。
items.wrongSimplified: 他去一次洗手间，马上回来。

right.traditional: 他去一下洗手間，馬上回來。
right.simplified: 他去一下洗手间，马上回来。
right.pinyin: Tā qù yíxià xǐshǒujiān, mǎshàng huílái.
right.english: He stepped into the restroom for a moment and will be right back.

items.question: Where does the object go?
items.answer: 「一下」放在動詞後面；有賓語時，賓語放在「一下」後面，例如「等我一下」、「看一下菜單」。
items.wrongTraditional: 你可以看一下嗎菜單？
items.wrongSimplified: 你可以看一下吗菜单？

right.traditional: 你可以看一下菜單嗎？
right.simplified: 你可以看一下菜单吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ kàn yíxià càidān ma?
right.english: Could you take a quick look at the menu?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 一下 after a verb to say the action lasts only a short time or is done a little. If the object is named, it can follow 一下, as in 介紹一下你自己.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This grammar indicates the action of the verb lasts for a short time or the amount of action is quite small.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give warm, practical advice about what someone should do.
grammarPages.explanation: 「最好」後面常接動詞詞組，用來建議別人做某件事。內容可以是肯定或否定，例如「最好不要一個人去」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 最好 + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 你最好去看醫生，聽聽醫生怎麼說。
text.simplified: 你最好去看医生，听听医生怎么说。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng, tīngting yīshēng zěnme shuō.
text.english: You had better see a doctor and hear what they say.

text.traditional: 我們最好每天下了課就去圖書館念書。
text.simplified: 我们最好每天下了课就去图书馆念书。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen zuìhǎo měi tiān xià le kè jiù qù túshūguǎn niànshū.
text.english: We had better go to the library to study every day after class.

words.meaning: then go study at the library

text.traditional: 你最好不要一個人去。
text.simplified: 你最好不要一个人去。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo búyào yí ge rén qù.
text.english: You had better not go alone.

items.question: Is 最好 only for the best choice?
items.answer: 不只是。這裡的「最好」是給建議的固定說法，不等於「第一名」。
items.wrongTraditional: 你去看最好的醫生。
items.wrongSimplified: 你去看最好的医生。

right.traditional: 你最好去看醫生。
right.simplified: 你最好去看医生。
right.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo qù kàn yīshēng.
right.english: You had better see a doctor.

items.question: Can 最好 be followed by a noun?
items.answer: 不行。「最好」後面要接動詞詞組，說「最好去」、「最好休息」，不能直接接名詞。
items.wrongTraditional: 你最好醫生。
items.wrongSimplified: 你最好医生。

right.traditional: 你最好休息一下。
right.simplified: 你最好休息一下。
right.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi yíxià.
right.english: You had better rest a little.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 最好 before a verb phrase to give advice about what action would be best. For negative advice, use 最好不要 before the action.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This expression, often followed by a verb phrase, is used to give advice about what someone should do.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a second true point with 也 instead of stopping after the first.
grammarPages.explanation: 「不但……也……」連接兩個詞組或句子，表示兩種情況同時存在。兩部分主題相同時，「不但」放在主題後、第一個詞組前，「也」連接另一個詞組。若兩部分說的是不同方面，「也」放在第二個方面前，例如「風景美，交通也很方便」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但 + Clause 1 + 也 + Clause 2

text.traditional: 我不但想吃小籠包，也想吃牛肉麵。
text.simplified: 我不但想吃小笼包，也想吃牛肉面。
text.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn xiǎng chī xiǎolóngbāo, yě xiǎng chī niúròumiàn.
text.english: I not only want xiaolongbao, but also want beef noodles.

text.traditional: 學中文不但很有意思，也比較容易找工作。
text.simplified: 学中文不但很有意思，也比较容易找工作。
text.pinyin: Xué Zhōngwén búdàn hěn yǒu yìsi, yě bǐjiào róngyì zhǎo gōngzuò.
text.english: Learning Chinese is not only interesting; it also makes finding a job easier.

text.traditional: 因為台灣不但風景美，交通也很方便。
text.simplified: 因为台湾不但风景美，交通也很方便。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi Táiwān búdàn fēngjǐng měi, jiāotōng yě hěn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Because Taiwan not only has beautiful scenery, but its transport is also convenient.

items.question: Does 也 come before or after the second point?
items.answer: 「也」放在第二個特點或動作的前面，例如「也很好」、「也想去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 我不但想去台灣，想也去日本。
items.wrongSimplified: 我不但想去台湾，想也去日本。

right.traditional: 我不但想去台灣，也想去日本。
right.simplified: 我不但想去台湾，也想去日本。
right.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn xiǎng qù Táiwān, yě xiǎng qù Rìběn.
right.english: I not only want to go to Taiwan, but also want to go to Japan.

words.meaning: I not only want to go to Taiwan
also want to go to Japan

items.question: Where does 不但 go when the subject is the same?
items.answer: 「不但」放在主語後面、第一個詞組前面；不能放在主語前面。
items.wrongTraditional: 不但我喜歡看書，也喜歡運動。
items.wrongSimplified: 不但我喜欢看书，也喜欢运动。

right.traditional: 我不但喜歡看書，也喜歡運動。
right.simplified: 我不但喜欢看书，也喜欢运动。
right.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn xǐhuan kànshū, yě xǐhuan yùndòng.
right.english: I not only like reading, but also like sports.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 不但 before the first fact or action and 也 before the second to say that both apply. With one shared topic, put 不但 after that topic. When the two parts describe different aspects of one topic, put 也 before the second aspect, as in 風景美，交通也很方便.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “不但……，也……” pattern connects two phrases or clauses and indicates the two situations exist at the same time. If “不但” and “也” have the same topic, “不但” should come after the topic, connect with a phrase, and “也” connects with another phrase. If related to different aspects, “也” should come after the second aspect.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say an action is completely finished, and ask whether it is done yet.
grammarPages.explanation: 「完」放在動詞後面，當結果補語，表示動作已經做完、結束。肯定說「V完了」，還沒做完說「還沒V完」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 完 (+ 了)

text.traditional: 今天的作業不多，我很快就寫完了。
text.simplified: 今天的作业不多，我很快就写完了。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān de zuòyè bù duō, wǒ hěn kuài jiù xiě wán le.
text.english: There is not much homework today; I finished writing it quickly.

words.meaning: there is not much homework today

text.traditional: 聽說上個星期就賣完了。
text.simplified: 听说上个星期就卖完了。
text.pinyin: Tīngshuō shàng ge xīngqī jiù mài wán le.
text.english: I heard they sold out last week.

text.traditional: 這個禮拜我很忙，還沒看完。
text.simplified: 这个礼拜我很忙，还没看完。
text.pinyin: Zhège lǐbài wǒ hěn máng, hái méi kàn wán.
text.english: I have been busy this week, so I have not finished reading it yet.

items.question: Does 完 mean the same as 了?
items.answer: 不一樣。「完」說動作做完了；「了」只表示動作完成或情況改變，不一定全部做完。
items.wrongTraditional: 我吃了完飯。
items.wrongSimplified: 我吃了完饭。

right.traditional: 我吃完飯了。
right.simplified: 我吃完饭了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ chī wán fàn le.
right.english: I have finished eating.

items.question: How do you say it is not finished yet?
items.answer: 用「還沒V完」：還沒看完、還沒寫完、還沒賣完。
items.wrongTraditional: 我不看完這本書。
items.wrongSimplified: 我不看完这本书。

right.traditional: 這本書我還沒看完。
right.simplified: 这本书我还没看完。
right.pinyin: Zhè běn shū wǒ hái méi kàn wán.
right.english: I have not finished reading this book yet.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 完 directly after a verb to show that the action is finished. It can be followed by 了 (V完了); 還沒V完 says the action is not finished yet. Here 完 is a result complement, not the standalone word 完 meaning “to be finished.”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The expression indicates that an action is finished. The “完”, serving as a verb complement, means “done” or “finished”.

items.title: Grammar 5–9 · The First Time They Met

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介本來是一個害羞的日本學生，來台灣以後，他住在學校的宿舍，認識了很多朋友，常常跟他們去吃飯、打球。放假的時候，朋友帶他去參觀博物館、看表演，所以他覺得在台灣的生活很快樂，也好像不那麼害羞了。
lines.simplified: 山本良介本来是一个害羞的日本学生，来台湾以后，他住在学校的宿舍，认识了很多朋友，常常跟他们去吃饭、打球。放假的时候，朋友带他去参观博物馆、看表演，所以他觉得在台湾的生活很快乐，也好像不那么害羞了。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè běnlái shì yí ge hàixiū de Rìběn xuésheng, lái Táiwān yǐhòu, tā zhù zài xuéxiào de sùshè, rènshi le hěn duō péngyou, chángcháng gēn tāmen qù chīfàn, dǎqiú. Fàngjià de shíhou, péngyou dài tā qù cānguān bówùguǎn, kàn biǎoyǎn, suǒyǐ tā juéde zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn kuàilè, yě hǎoxiàng bú nàme hàixiū le.
lines.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto was originally a shy Japanese student. After coming to Taiwan, he lived in the school dormitory, met many friends, and often went out to eat and play ball with them. During holidays, his friends took him to visit museums and watch performances, so he felt that life in Taiwan was very happy, and he seemed to become less shy.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 有一天，他在網路上認識了一個女生，她是台灣的大學生。因為她覺得跟不熟的男生約會很危險，所以一直不敢跟良介見面。後來良介寄給她一張卡片，請她跟她的朋友來學校參加舞會。不久，他們就在學校見面了。他們見面的時候，良介的心跳得很快。
lines.simplified: 有一天，他在网路上认识了一个女生，她是台湾的大学生。因为她觉得跟不熟的男生约会很危险，所以一直不敢跟良介见面。后来良介寄给她一张卡片，请她跟她的朋友来学校参加舞会。不久，他们就在学校见面了。他们见面的时候，良介的心跳得很快。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài wǎnglù shàng rènshi le yí ge nǚshēng, tā shì Táiwān de dàxuéshēng. Yīnwèi tā juéde gēn bù shóu de nánshēng yuēhuì hěn wēixiǎn, suǒyǐ yìzhí bù gǎn gēn Liángjiè jiànmiàn. Hòulái Liángjiè jì gěi tā yì zhāng kǎpiàn, qǐng tā gēn tā de péngyou lái xuéxiào cānjiā wǔhuì. Bùjiǔ, tāmen jiù zài xuéxiào jiànmiàn le. Tāmen jiànmiàn de shíhou, Liángjiè de xīn tiào de hěn kuài.
lines.english: One day he met a girl online; she was a Taiwanese university student. Because she thought dating a man she did not know well was dangerous, she had never dared meet Ryosuke. Later Ryosuke sent her a card and invited her and her friends to a dance party at school. Soon afterward, they met at school. When they met, Ryosuke's heart beat very fast.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那天，他們一邊跳舞，一邊聊天，兩個人都很開心。良介覺得那個女生不但很漂亮，個性也很好，很想趕快再跟她約會。舞會結束以後，他們在學校裡散步，良介不好意思拉她的手，只跟她說，能認識她真的很幸運，希望以後有機會再跟她見面。
lines.simplified: 那天，他们一边跳舞，一边聊天，两个人都很开心。良介觉得那个女生不但很漂亮，个性也很好，很想赶快再跟她约会。舞会结束以后，他们在学校里散步，良介不好意思拉她的手，只跟她说，能认识她真的很幸运，希望以后有机会再跟她见面。
lines.pinyin: Nà tiān, tāmen yìbiān tiàowǔ, yìbiān liáotiān, liǎng ge rén dōu hěn kāixīn. Liángjiè juéde nàge nǚshēng búdàn hěn piàoliang, gèxìng yě hěn hǎo, hěn xiǎng gǎnkuài zài gēn tā yuēhuì. Wǔhuì jiéshù yǐhòu, tāmen zài xuéxiào lǐ sànbù, Liángjiè bù hǎoyìsi lā tā de shǒu, zhǐ gēn tā shuō, néng rènshi tā zhēn de hěn xìngyùn, xīwàng yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì zài gēn tā jiànmiàn.
lines.english: That day they danced and chatted at the same time, and both were very happy. Ryosuke thought the girl was not only beautiful but also had a great personality, and he wanted to go on another date with her soon. After the dance ended, they took a walk around the school. Ryosuke was too embarrassed to hold her hand, and only told her that he was truly lucky to meet her and hoped to see her again.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 那個女生覺得雖然良介是外國人，中文也說得不太好，可是他們的興趣一樣，都喜歡看書、運動，而且跟他在一起很安全、很有意思。現在他們不但常常上網聊天，也會一起去打籃球、騎腳踏車呢！
lines.simplified: 那个女生觉得虽然良介是外国人，中文也说得不太好，可是他们的兴趣一样，都喜欢看书、运动，而且跟他在一起很安全、很有意思。现在他们不但常常上网聊天，也会一起去打篮球、骑脚踏车呢！
lines.pinyin: Nàge nǚshēng juéde suīrán Liángjiè shì wàiguórén, Zhōngwén yě shuō de bú tài hǎo, kěshì tāmen de xìngqù yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan kànshū, yùndòng, érqiě gēn tā zài yìqǐ hěn ānquán, hěn yǒu yìsi. Xiànzài tāmen búdàn chángcháng shàngwǎng liáotiān, yě huì yìqǐ qù dǎ lánqiú, qí jiǎotàchē ne!
lines.english: The girl felt that although Ryosuke was a foreigner and did not speak Chinese very well, they had the same interests—they both liked reading and sports—and she felt safe and found being with him interesting. Now they not only chat online often, but also play basketball and ride bicycles together.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where someone or something sits, stands, lives, or is placed.
grammarPages.explanation: 句型是「動詞＋在＋地點」，表示人或東西經過動作後所在的位置。書上列出的常見動詞是「住、坐、站」；例句也用「放」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 在 + Location

text.traditional: 爸爸忘了他的手機放在哪裡了。
text.simplified: 爸爸忘了他的手机放在哪里了。
text.pinyin: Bàba wàng le tā de shǒujī fàng zài nǎlǐ le.
text.english: Dad forgot where he put his phone.

text.traditional: 你不要站在那麼高的地方，很危險！
text.simplified: 你不要站在那么高的地方，很危险！
text.pinyin: Nǐ búyào zhàn zài nàme gāo de dìfāng, hěn wēixiǎn!
text.english: Don't stand in such a high place—it is dangerous!

text.traditional: 我住在捷運站附近，走路五分鐘就到了。
text.simplified: 我住在捷运站附近，走路五分钟就到了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhù zài jiéyùnzhàn fùjìn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
text.english: I live near the MRT station; it is a five-minute walk.

items.question: Is 住在 only for people?
items.answer: 不是。「住在」用於居住；東西的位置用「放在、寫在、停在」等，動詞要配合。
items.wrongTraditional: 手機住在桌子上。
items.wrongSimplified: 手机住在桌子上。

right.traditional: 手機放在桌子上。
right.simplified: 手机放在桌子上。
right.pinyin: Shǒujī fàng zài zhuōzi shàng.
right.english: The phone is on the desk.

items.question: Where does 在 go?
items.answer: 「在」放在動詞後面、地點前面：坐在、站在、住在。不能說「在坐」。
items.wrongTraditional: 孩子在椅子上坐。
items.wrongSimplified: 孩子在椅子上坐。

right.traditional: 孩子坐在椅子上。
right.simplified: 孩子坐在椅子上。
right.pinyin: Háizi zuò zài yǐzi shàng.
right.english: The child is sitting on the chair.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 在 after the verb and before the location to say where a person or thing is, or where an action places it: Verb + 在 + Location. The book commonly uses 住, 坐, 站, 放, and 寫 before 在.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The structure of the pattern is “V在+Location”. The verbs often placed before “在” include “住 (live)”, “坐 (sit)” and “站 (stand)”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Mark who receives a thing or a message after verbs like 送、賣、寄、拿.
grammarPages.explanation: 「給」放在動詞後面，引出動作的接受者，表示東西或訊息往誰那裡去。常見組合有「送給、賣給、寄給、拿給、帶給、寫給」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 給 + Receiver

text.traditional: 那些書，我送給朋友了。
text.simplified: 那些书，我送给朋友了。
text.pinyin: Nàxiē shū, wǒ sòng gěi péngyou le.
text.english: I gave those books to a friend.

text.traditional: 王先生的舊車賣給張小姐了。
text.simplified: 王先生的旧车卖给张小姐了。
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng de jiù chē mài gěi Zhāng xiǎojiě le.
text.english: Mr. Wang sold his old car to Miss Zhang.

text.traditional: 我拿著電話，可是忘了要打給誰了。
text.simplified: 我拿着电话，可是忘了要打给谁了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ názhe diànhuà, kěshì wàng le yào dǎ gěi shéi le.
text.english: I was holding the phone but forgot whom I meant to call.

text.traditional: 桌上的水果，你拿給誰吃了？
text.simplified: 桌上的水果，你拿给谁吃了？
text.pinyin: Zhuō shàng de shuǐguǒ, nǐ ná gěi shéi chī le?
text.english: Who did you give the fruit on the table to?

text.traditional: 我沒聽過十二生肖的故事，你可以說給我聽嗎？
text.simplified: 我没听过十二生肖的故事，你可以说给我听吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ méi tīngguò shí'èr shēngxiào de gùshì, nǐ kěyǐ shuō gěi wǒ tīng ma?
text.english: I have never heard the story of the twelve zodiac animals. Could you tell it to me?

words.meaning: the story of the twelve zodiac animals

items.question: Is 給 a verb or a preposition here?
items.answer: 在「V給」裡，「給」是介詞，前面一定要有動詞：送給、寄給、拿給。
items.wrongTraditional: 我給朋友送了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我给朋友送了。

right.traditional: 我送給朋友了。
right.simplified: 我送给朋友了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ sòng gěi péngyou le.
right.english: I gave it to a friend.

items.question: Does the receiver come before or after 給?
items.answer: 接受者放在「給」後面：寄給媽媽、賣給客人。
items.wrongTraditional: 我寄給卡片媽媽了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我寄给卡片妈妈了。

right.traditional: 我寄給媽媽一張卡片。
right.simplified: 我寄给妈妈一张卡片。
right.pinyin: Wǒ jì gěi māma yì zhāng kǎpiàn.
right.english: I mailed Mom a card.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 給 after the verb and before the recipient to show who receives the action: Verb + 給 + Person. Common examples include 送給, 賣給, 拿給, and 寄給.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “給” functions as a preposition that comes after a verb, shows the direction, and marks the recipient of an action.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two actions happening at the same time, with one or two subjects.
grammarPages.explanation: 「（一）邊……（一）邊……」表示兩個動作在同一時間或地點發生，通常接具體的動作動詞。句子可以有一個主語，也可以有兩個主語；省略「一」時只能有一個主語。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一邊 + Action 1 + 一邊 + Action 2

text.traditional: 有人一邊走路一邊玩手機，真危險。
text.simplified: 有人一边走路一边玩手机，真危险。
text.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān wán shǒujī, zhēn wēixiǎn.
text.english: Some people walk and use their phones at the same time; that is really dangerous.

text.traditional: 很多學生喜歡一邊聽音樂，一邊念書。
text.simplified: 很多学生喜欢一边听音乐，一边念书。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō xuésheng xǐhuan yìbiān tīng yīnyuè, yìbiān niànshū.
text.english: Many students like to listen to music while studying.

text.traditional: 上課的時候，老師一邊說，學生一邊寫。
text.simplified: 上课的时候，老师一边说，学生一边写。
text.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhou, lǎoshī yìbiān shuō, xuésheng yìbiān xiě.
text.english: In class, the teacher talks while the students write.

items.question: Do the two actions happen one after another?
items.answer: 不，必須同時發生。「一邊吃飯，一邊看電視」是同時；先吃完再看，不能這樣說。
items.wrongTraditional: 他一邊吃完飯，一邊去上班。
items.wrongSimplified: 他一边吃完饭，一边去上班。

right.traditional: 他一邊吃飯，一邊看電視。
right.simplified: 他一边吃饭，一边看电视。
right.pinyin: Tā yìbiān chīfàn, yìbiān kàn diànshì.
right.english: He eats while watching TV.

items.question: Can 一 be left out?
items.answer: 同一個主語時可以：「他邊唱邊跳」。兩個主語時不能省，要說「老師一邊說，學生一邊寫」。
items.wrongTraditional: 老師說，學生一邊寫。
items.wrongSimplified: 老师说，学生一边写。

right.traditional: 老師一邊說，學生一邊寫。
right.simplified: 老师一边说，学生一边写。
right.pinyin: Lǎoshī yìbiān shuō, xuésheng yìbiān xiě.
right.english: The teacher talks while the students write.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 一邊 before each of two actions to show that they happen at the same time. One person can do both actions, or two people can each do one. When a single person does both, 一 may be omitted from both sides (邊……邊……).
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “（一）邊……（，）（一）邊……” pattern implies that the two actions coming after each “一邊” happen at the same time or at the same place. This pattern is mostly used in modifying concrete action verbs and it can be used in sentences with only one subject or in complex sentences with two subjects, eg. “他一邊唱，我一邊跳。”. If “一” is omitted, there should be only one subject in the sentence, eg. “他邊唱邊跳。”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Admit one fact, then give the surprising or contrasting result.
grammarPages.explanation: 「雖然……可是……」先承認一個事實，再說出意料之外或相反的情況。轉折的語氣由「可是」承擔，前後兩部分都要出現。
grammarPages.pattern: 雖然 + Clause 1 + 可是 + Clause 2

columns.meaning: Chinese is not easy to learn

columns.pinyin: kěshì wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìsi

text.traditional: 雖然不容易，可是我覺得很有意思。
text.simplified: 虽然不容易，可是我觉得很有意思。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bù róngyì, kěshì wǒ juéde hěn yǒu yìsi.
text.english: Although it is not easy, I find it very interesting.

text.traditional: 雖然他很聰明，可是不喜歡讀書，所以考得不好。
text.simplified: 虽然他很聪明，可是不喜欢读书，所以考得不好。
text.pinyin: Suīrán tā hěn cōngming, kěshì bù xǐhuan dúshū, suǒyǐ kǎo de bù hǎo.
text.english: Although he is clever, he does not like studying, so he did not do well on the test.

words.meaning: but he does not like studying

text.traditional: 雖然不舒服，可是今天公司有很重要的事，一定要去。
text.simplified: 虽然不舒服，可是今天公司有很重要的事，一定要去。
text.pinyin: Suīrán bù shūfu, kěshì jīntiān gōngsī yǒu hěn zhòngyào de shì, yídìng yào qù.
text.english: Although I feel unwell, something very important is happening at the company today, so I must go.

words.traditional: 可是今天公司有很重要的事
words.simplified: 可是今天公司有很重要的事
words.pinyin: kěshì jīntiān gōngsī yǒu hěn zhòngyào de shì
words.meaning: but the company has something important today

items.question: Is 可是 the same as 所以?
items.answer: 不是。「可是」表示轉折，「所以」表示結果。雖然……可是……不能換成「雖然……所以……」。
items.wrongTraditional: 雖然下雨，所以我們還是去公園。
items.wrongSimplified: 虽然下雨，所以我们还是去公园。

right.traditional: 雖然下雨，可是我們還是去公園。
right.simplified: 虽然下雨，可是我们还是去公园。
right.pinyin: Suīrán xiàyǔ, kěshì wǒmen háishì qù gōngyuán.
right.english: Although it is raining, we are still going to the park.

words.meaning: but we are still going to the park

items.question: Can the second half use 也 instead of 可是?
items.answer: 不行。「也」只是補充，不能標出轉折；這裡需要「可是」或「但是」。
items.wrongTraditional: 雖然很貴，我也買了。
items.wrongSimplified: 虽然很贵，我也买了。

right.traditional: 雖然很貴，可是我還是買了。
right.simplified: 虽然很贵，可是我还是买了。
right.pinyin: Suīrán hěn guì, kěshì wǒ háishì mǎi le.
right.english: Although it was expensive, I still bought it.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 雖然 before a fact the speaker accepts, then 可是 before the outcome that is unexpected despite that fact. The second clause gives the contrast.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern implies that the speaker agrees to the information coming after “雖然” but the information coming after “可是” is unexpected.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize a fact politely, as if saying 'you know' or 'actually'.
grammarPages.explanation: 句末的「呢」用在陳述句，強調前面的動作或事實，語氣禮貌、輕鬆，像在補充說明。它和疑問句裡的「呢」不同。
grammarPages.pattern: Statement + 呢！

columns.meaning: is very close to my home
has been studying in his room

text.traditional: 不，他家離我家很近呢！
text.simplified: 不，他家离我家很近呢！
text.pinyin: Bù, tā jiā lí wǒ jiā hěn jìn ne!
text.english: No—his home is actually very close to mine!

text.traditional: 可是我覺得很好看，想再看一次呢！
text.simplified: 可是我觉得很好看，想再看一次呢！
text.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ juéde hěn hǎokàn, xiǎng zài kàn yí cì ne!
text.english: But I think it is really good—I actually want to see it again!

words.pinyin: xiǎng zài kàn yí cì ne
words.meaning: actually want to watch it again

text.traditional: 他沒出去玩，他一直在房間讀書呢！
text.simplified: 他没出去玩，他一直在房间读书呢！
text.pinyin: Tā méi chūqù wán, tā yìzhí zài fángjiān dúshū ne!
text.english: He did not go out to play—he has been studying in his room!

words.meaning: he has been in the room

items.question: Does 呢 turn a statement into a question?
items.answer: 不是。句末「呢」用在陳述句，是強調；一般問句用「嗎」，或把「呢」放在名詞後面問「……呢？」。
items.wrongTraditional: 你喜歡喝茶呢？
items.wrongSimplified: 你喜欢喝茶呢？

right.traditional: 你喜歡喝茶嗎？
right.simplified: 你喜欢喝茶吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ xǐhuan hē chá ma?
right.english: Do you like drinking tea?

items.question: Is 呢 the same as 吧?
items.answer: 不同。「吧」表示猜測或建議；「呢」表示強調、補充事實，語氣更確定。
items.wrongTraditional: 他一直在房間讀書吧！
items.wrongSimplified: 他一直在房间读书吧！

right.traditional: 他一直在房間讀書呢！
right.simplified: 他一直在房间读书呢！
right.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài fángjiān dúshū ne!
right.english: He has been studying in his room, you know!

words.meaning: he has been studying in his room

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put sentence-final 呢 after a statement to add the speaker’s emphasis or personal tone, often making it sound gentle or polite. This use is different from 呢 in a question such as asking where someone is.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This particle “呢”, often placed at the end of a sentence, is used to emphasize that the foregoing action or fact is based on the speaker’s personal opinion. It shows a tone of politeness. The “呢” used here is different from that used in an interrogative sentence.

items.title: Grammar 1–9 · I Have to Do Housework

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 今天是開學的第一天，功課不多，我們一起去看球賽或是電影吧！
lines.simplified: 今天是开学的第一天，功课不多，我们一起去看球赛或是电影吧！
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān shì kāixué de dì yī tiān, gōngkè bù duō, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn qiúsài huòshì diànyǐng ba!
lines.english: Today is the first day of school. We don't have much homework. Let's go watch a ball game or movie together!

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 我不能去。我得先去我父母的餐廳幫忙，把桌子擦了，再把碗筷、刀叉洗一洗。
lines.simplified: 我不能去。我得先去我父母的餐厅帮忙，把桌子擦了，再把碗筷、刀叉洗一洗。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù néng qù. Wǒ děi xiān qù wǒ fùmǔ de cāntīng bāngmáng, bǎ zhuōzi cā le, zài bǎ wǎnkuài, dāochā xǐ yī xǐ.
lines.english: I can't go. I have to go to my parents' restaurant to help them wipe the tables first, and then wash the bowls, chopsticks, knives and forks.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 做那些事情要多久？
lines.simplified: 做那些事情要多久？
lines.pinyin: Zuò nàxiē shìqing yào duōjiǔ?
lines.english: How long will it take to do those things?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 客人多的時候差不多要兩個小時。
lines.simplified: 客人多的时候差不多要两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Kèrén duō de shíhou chàbuduō yào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: It takes about two hours when there are a lot of customers.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 要那麼久啊？
lines.simplified: 要那么久啊？
lines.pinyin: Yào nàme jiǔ a?
lines.english: It takes that long?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 對啊，因為碗筷洗完了還得擦乾。有時候客人丟了東西，非常著急，我就得幫他們找一找，把東西拿給他們。
lines.simplified: 对啊，因为碗筷洗完了还得擦干。有时候客人丢了东西，非常着急，我就得帮他们找一找，把东西拿给他们。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, yīnwèi wǎnkuài xǐ wán le hái děi cāgān. Yǒu shíhou kèrén diū le dōngxi, fēicháng zhāojí, wǒ jiù děi bāng tāmen zhǎo yī zhǎo, bǎ dōngxi ná gěi tāmen.
lines.english: Yes, because I have to wipe them dry after washing them. Sometimes when customers lose something and they are very anxious, I have to help them look for it and give it to them.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 那些事情做完以後，你就有空去看球賽了，對吧？
lines.simplified: 那些事情做完以后，你就有空去看球赛了，对吧？
lines.pinyin: Nàxiē shìqing zuò wán yǐhòu, nǐ jiù yǒukòng qù kàn qiúsài le, duì ba?
lines.english: After those things are finished, you're free to go watch a ball game, right?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 不，我得趕快回家。媽媽說我的房間太髒了，叫我今天一定要打掃。
lines.simplified: 不，我得赶快回家。妈妈说我的房间太脏了，叫我今天一定要打扫。
lines.pinyin: Bù, wǒ děi gǎnkuài huí jiā. Māma shuō wǒ de fángjiān tài zāng le, jiào wǒ jīntiān yídìng yào dǎsǎo.
lines.english: No, I need to hurry home. My mom said that my room is too dirty, and I must do the cleaning today.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 你的房間有多髒啊？晚一點兒再打掃，應該沒關係吧？
lines.simplified: 你的房间有多脏啊？晚一点儿再打扫，应该没关系吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de fángjiān yǒu duō zāng a? Wǎn yìdiǎnr zài dǎsǎo, yīnggāi méiguānxi ba?
lines.english: How dirty is your room? It should be ok if you clean it later, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 我已經三個月沒掃地了。
lines.simplified: 我已经三个月没扫地了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng sān ge yuè méi sǎodì le.
lines.english: I haven't swept the floor for three months.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太久了吧！暑假那麼長，你什麼事都沒做嗎？
lines.simplified: 太久了吧！暑假那么长，你什么事都没做吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài jiǔ le ba! Shǔjià nàme cháng, nǐ shénme shì dōu méi zuò ma?
lines.english: It's too long! The summer vacation was so long. Didn't you do anything?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 我先去日本玩了十天，回台灣以後，又跟朋友去南部玩了兩個星期。
lines.simplified: 我先去日本玩了十天，回台湾以后，又跟朋友去南部玩了两个星期。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān qù Rìběn wán le shí tiān, huí Táiwān yǐhòu, yòu gēn péngyou qù nánbù wán le liǎng ge xīngqí.
lines.english: I went on a trip to Japan for ten days first. After coming back to Taiwan, I went traveling with my friends in southern Taiwan for two weeks.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 你玩了這麼多天，功課做了沒有？
lines.simplified: 你玩了这么多天，功课做了没有？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ wán le zhème duō tiān, gōngkè zuò le méiyǒu?
lines.english: You went on a trip for so many days. Did you do your homework?

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 暑假快結束的時候，我才看完老師要我們看的書，當然就沒時間打掃了。
lines.simplified: 暑假快结束的时候，我才看完老师要我们看的书，当然就没时间打扫了。
lines.pinyin: Shǔjià kuài jiéshù de shíhou, wǒ cái kàn wán lǎoshī yào wǒmen kàn de shū, dāngrán jiù méi shíjiān dǎsǎo le.
lines.english: When the summer vacation was about to end, I just finished reading the book the teacher had asked us to read. Of course I didn't have time to do the cleaning.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 可是如果房間太亂，我會覺得不舒服，也沒辦法念書。
lines.simplified: 可是如果房间太乱，我会觉得不舒服，也没办法念书。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì rúguǒ fángjiān tài luàn, wǒ huì juéde bù shūfu, yě méi bànfǎ niànshū.
lines.english: But if my room is too messy, I will not only feel uncomfortable but also find myself unable to study.

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 對了，我家裡有一些中文小說，我覺得把那些書都丟了很可惜，送給你好嗎？
lines.simplified: 对了，我家里有一些中文小说，我觉得把那些书都丢了很可惜，送给你好吗？
lines.pinyin: Duì le, wǒ jiā lǐ yǒu yìxiē Zhōngwén xiǎoshuō, wǒ juéde bǎ nàxiē shū dōu diū le hěn kěxí, sòng gěi nǐ hǎo ma?
lines.english: By the way, there are some Chinese novels in my house. I think it is a pity to throw them away. Can I give them to you?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 好啊！那些書對我學中文很有用。我先回宿舍把功課寫完，就去你家拿。
lines.simplified: 好啊！那些书对我学中文很有用。我先回宿舍把功课写完，就去你家拿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nàxiē shū duì wǒ xué Zhōngwén hěn yǒuyòng. Wǒ xiān huí sùshè bǎ gōngkè xiě wán, jiù qù nǐ jiā ná.
lines.english: Sure! Those books are very useful and can help me learn Chinese. I will get them from your house after I go back to the dormitory to finish my homework.

lines.speaker: 同學
lines.traditional: 太好了！這樣你就可以跟我一起打掃了。
lines.simplified: 太好了！这样你就可以跟我一起打扫了。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zhèyàng nǐ jiù kěyǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ dǎsǎo le.
lines.english: That's great! Then you can do some cleaning with me.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 哈哈哈！
lines.simplified: 哈哈哈！
lines.pinyin: Hāhāhā!
lines.english: Hahaha!

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction: doing something to an object
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 to say what you do to a thing and how the action ends.
grammarPages.explanation: 「把」字句把要處理的受詞放在動詞前，並說明主語對它做了什麼以及造成什麼結果。這一部分要求動詞是有對外作用的及物動詞，例如「看、吃、賣、寫」。否定詞「不、沒、別」放在「把」前面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (Negation) + 把 + Noun + Verb + 了

columns.meaning: did not 把 the old car

text.traditional: 爸爸把晚餐吃了嗎？
text.simplified: 爸爸把晚餐吃了吗？
text.pinyin: Bàba bǎ wǎncān chī le ma?
text.english: Did Dad eat the dinner?

text.traditional: 王先生沒把舊車賣了。
text.simplified: 王先生没把旧车卖了。
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng méi bǎ jiù chē mài le.
text.english: Mr. Wang did not sell the old car.

text.traditional: 哥哥把牛奶喝了，就去睡覺了。
text.simplified: 哥哥把牛奶喝了，就去睡觉了。
text.pinyin: Gēge bǎ niúnǎi hē le, jiù qù shuìjiào le.
text.english: My older brother drank the milk and then went to bed.

items.question: 「把」後面的動詞只說「吃」可以嗎？
items.answer: 不行。把字句的動詞後面要有結果：吃了、吃完、吃一吃。
items.wrongTraditional: 爸爸把晚餐吃嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 爸爸把晚餐吃吗？

right.traditional: 爸爸把晚餐吃了嗎？
right.simplified: 爸爸把晚餐吃了吗？
right.pinyin: Bàba bǎ wǎncān chī le ma?
right.english: Did Dad eat the dinner?

items.question: 「不、沒、別」要放在哪裡？
items.answer: 放在「把」前面：沒把舊車賣了、別把垃圾丟在這裡。
items.wrongTraditional: 王先生把舊車沒賣了。
items.wrongSimplified: 王先生把旧车没卖了。

right.traditional: 王先生沒把舊車賣了。
right.simplified: 王先生没把旧车卖了。
right.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng méi bǎ jiù chē mài le.
right.english: Mr. Wang did not sell the old car.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 before a specific object when the sentence focuses on what is done to it. Put the action after the object, often with a result such as 了. If the sentence is negative, put 不, 沒, or 別 before 把. The verb should describe an action that acts on the object.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “把 construction”, also known as “disposal construction”, refers to how the Object is disposed of by the Subject through certain actions and cause certain result. Because this pattern often consists of a variety of complicated elements, the lesson begins with the most basic structure. The verbs used here must be outward and transitive, such as “看 (to see)”, “吃 (to eat)”, “賣 (to sell)”, and “寫 (to write)”. In negative sentences, negation words “不”, “沒” or “別” should be placed before “把”.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with the result 完
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that a task is finished: 把家事做完、把工作做完.
grammarPages.explanation: 「完」放在動詞後面，表示動作結束。把字句用它說某件事已經做完，例如「把家事做完」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (Negation) + 把 + Noun + Verb + 完

text.traditional: 媽媽把家事做完以後，就休息了。
text.simplified: 妈妈把家事做完以后，就休息了。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ jiāshì zuò wán yǐhòu, jiù xiūxi le.
text.english: After Mom finished the housework, she rested.

text.traditional: 因為你沒把工作做完，所以老闆不太高興。
text.simplified: 因为你没把工作做完，所以老闆不太高兴。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ méi bǎ gōngzuò zuò wán, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
text.english: Because you didn't finish the work, the boss is not very happy.

text.traditional: 請你先聽我把話說完，你再說，好嗎？
text.simplified: 请你先听我把话说完，你再说，好吗？
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiān tīng wǒ bǎ huà shuō wán, nǐ zài shuō, hǎo ma?
text.english: Please listen to me finish speaking before you speak, okay?

items.question: 「我完了」和「我做完」一樣嗎？
items.answer: 不一樣。「我完了」是「我沒希望了」；「做完」表示動作結束。
items.wrongTraditional: 媽媽把家事完做以後，就休息了。
items.wrongSimplified: 妈妈把家事完做以后，就休息了。

right.traditional: 媽媽把家事做完以後，就休息了。
right.simplified: 妈妈把家事做完以后，就休息了。
right.pinyin: Māma bǎ jiāshì zuò wán yǐhòu, jiù xiūxi le.
right.english: After Mom finished the housework, she rested.

items.question: 「完」放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面：做完、洗完、看完。
items.wrongTraditional: 你沒把工作完做。
items.wrongSimplified: 你没把工作完做。

right.traditional: 因為你沒把工作做完，所以老闆不太高興。
right.simplified: 因为你没把工作做完，所以老板不太高兴。
right.pinyin: Yīnwèi nǐ méi bǎ gōngzuò zuò wán, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn bú tài gāoxìng.
right.english: Because you did not finish the work, the boss is not very happy.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 + object + verb + 完 to say that an action on that object has been completed. 完 follows the verb as a result complement, rather than acting as a verb by itself. This pattern describes finishing the action on the object.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This grammar denotes that the action of the verb is over. The “完” after the verb, used as the V complement, means to end or to finish. Pay attention to the usage of “完”. This lesson uses the complement structure to describe the end of the action instead of using the word “完” alone. For example, the meaning of “我完了。（I'm finished.）” is completely different from the V完 pattern.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with a repeated verb
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Make a request sound lighter: 把手洗一洗、把地掃一掃.
grammarPages.explanation: 動詞重疊成「V一V」，表示動作輕鬆、時間短，用在把字句裡讓請求或命令的語氣更客氣。這個用法只用單音節動詞。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Noun + Verb + 一 + Verb

text.traditional: 把你的手洗一洗，我們要吃飯了。
text.simplified: 把你的手洗一洗，我们要吃饭了。
text.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de shǒu xǐ yī xǐ, wǒmen yào chīfàn le.
text.english: Wash your hands; we are about to eat.

text.traditional: 回家以後，我先把垃圾倒一倒再去洗澡。
text.simplified: 回家以后，我先把垃圾倒一倒再去洗澡。
text.pinyin: Huí jiā yǐhòu, wǒ xiān bǎ lèsè dào yī dào zài qù xǐzǎo.
text.english: After going home, I first take out the garbage and then take a shower.

text.traditional: 太太：我覺得頭很疼，你可以幫我做家事嗎？先生：沒問題！我先把地掃一掃，等孩子回來以後，再把他們的髒衣服洗一洗。
text.simplified: 太太：我觉得头很疼，你可以帮我做家事吗？先生：没问题！我先把地扫一扫，等孩子回来以后，再把他们的脏衣服洗一洗。
text.pinyin: Tàitai：Wǒ juéde tóu hěn téng, nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ zuò jiāshì ma? Xiānsheng：Méi wèntí! Wǒ xiān bǎ dì sǎo yī sǎo, děng háizi huílái yǐhòu, zài bǎ tāmen de zāng yīfu xǐ yī xǐ.
text.english: Wife: I have a bad headache. Can you help me do the housework? Husband: No problem! I'll sweep the floor first, and after the children come back, I'll wash their dirty clothes.

words.pinyin: nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ zuò jiāshì ma
words.meaning: can you help me do the housework

words.pinyin: wǒ xiān bǎ dì sǎo yī sǎo
words.meaning: I will sweep the floor first

items.question: 「V一V」可以用兩個音節的動詞嗎？
items.answer: 不行。這個用法只用單音節動詞：洗一洗、掃一掃、倒一倒。
items.wrongTraditional: 你可以幫我把桌子擦一擦乾淨嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 你可以帮我把桌子擦一擦干净吗？

right.traditional: 你可以幫我把桌子擦一擦嗎？
right.simplified: 你可以帮我把桌子擦一擦吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhuōzi cā yī cā ma?
right.english: Can you help me wipe the table?

items.question: 「V一V」讓語氣更客氣還是更凶？
items.answer: 更客氣、更輕鬆：把你的手洗一洗、把地掃一掃。
items.wrongTraditional: 把你的手洗！
items.wrongSimplified: 把你的手洗！

right.traditional: 把你的手洗一洗。
right.simplified: 把你的手洗一洗。
right.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ de shǒu xǐ yī xǐ.
right.english: Wash your hands.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 + object + V一V for a short, simple action on that object. This reduplication makes a request or instruction sound gentler. The verb in V一V must be one syllable.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: The “V－V” pattern softens the tone and makes an action simple and clear. When used together with “把 construction”, it gives requests or orders in a gentler tone. However, the verb used in this pattern has to be monosyllabic.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with 給
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say who receives something: 把小說送給朋友、把舊車賣給你.
grammarPages.explanation: 「給」放在動詞後面，引出東西的接受者：送給朋友、賣給你、拿給孩子。把字句裡也一樣：把小說送給朋友。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Noun + Verb + 給 + Receiver

text.traditional: 我昨天把那些小說送給朋友了。
text.simplified: 我昨天把那些小说送给朋友了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān bǎ nàxiē xiǎoshuō sòng gěi péngyou le.
text.english: Yesterday I gave those novels to a friend.

text.traditional: 王先生為什麼不想把舊車賣給你？
text.simplified: 王先生为什么不想把旧车卖给你？
text.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng wèishénme bù xiǎng bǎ jiù chē mài gěi nǐ?
text.english: Why doesn't Mr. Wang want to sell the old car to you?

text.traditional: A：你昨天為什麼沒把感冒藥拿給孩子吃？B：醫生說那個藥是給大人吃的，不可以給小孩吃。
text.simplified: A：你昨天为什么没把感冒药拿给孩子吃？B：医生说那个药是给大人吃的，不可以给小孩吃。
text.pinyin: A：Nǐ zuótiān wèishénme méi bǎ gǎnmào yào ná gěi háizi chī? B：Yīshēng shuō nàge yào shì gěi dàrén chī de, bù kěyǐ gěi xiǎohái chī.
text.english: A: Why didn't you give the cold medicine to the child yesterday? B: The doctor said that medicine is for adults; it must not be given to children.

words.traditional: 你昨天為什麼沒把感冒藥拿給孩子吃
words.simplified: 你昨天为什么没把感冒药拿给孩子吃
words.pinyin: nǐ zuótiān wèishénme méi bǎ gǎnmào yào ná gěi háizi chī
words.meaning: why didn't you give the cold medicine to the child yesterday

words.traditional: 醫生說那個藥是給大人吃的
words.simplified: 医生说那个药是给大人吃的
words.pinyin: yīshēng shuō nàge yào shì gěi dàrén chī de
words.meaning: the doctor said that medicine is for adults
it must not be given to children

items.question: 「給」放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在動詞後面：送給、賣給、拿給；接受者放在「給」後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 我把小說給送朋友了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我把小说给送朋友了。

right.traditional: 我昨天把那些小說送給朋友了。
right.simplified: 我昨天把那些小说送给朋友了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān bǎ nàxiē xiǎoshuō sòng gěi péngyou le.
right.english: Yesterday I gave those novels to a friend.

items.question: 東西和接受者的順序是什麼？
items.answer: 先說東西，再說「V給」和接受者：把舊車賣給你。
items.wrongTraditional: 王先生為什麼不想把你賣給舊車？
items.wrongSimplified: 王先生为什么不想把你卖给旧车？

right.traditional: 王先生為什麼不想把舊車賣給你？
right.simplified: 王先生为什么不想把旧车卖给你？
right.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng wèishénme bù xiǎng bǎ jiù chē mài gěi nǐ?
right.english: Why doesn't Mr. Wang want to sell the old car to you?

words.meaning: why doesn't Mr. Wang want to

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 + object + verb + 給 + recipient to say that the object is acted on and passed, sent, or directed to someone. 給 comes after the verb and before the recipient; verbs in the book include 拿, 送, 賣, and 寄.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “給” is a preposition that indicates the direction of action and marks the recipient of the Direct Object. It can collocate with verbs “拿 (to take)”, “送 (to give)”, “賣 (to sell)”, “寄 (to send)”, “踢 (to kick)”, etc. It can also be used in 把 construction, such as “我把你做的蛋糕送給朋友了。”.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Ask how big, long, far, high or expensive something is: 多大、多長、多遠.
grammarPages.explanation: 「多」加上狀態動詞（如大、長、高、遠、重）用來問程度。「有」常省略：多大、有多遠。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (有) + 多 + Vs?

text.traditional: A：你家離學校（有）多遠？B：我家離學校很遠，走路差不多要五十分鐘。
text.simplified: A：你家离学校（有）多远？B：我家离学校很远，走路差不多要五十分钟。
text.pinyin: A：Nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào (yǒu) duō yuǎn? B：Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn, zǒulù chàbuduō yào wǔshí fēnzhōng.
text.english: A: How far is your home from school? B: My home is far from school; walking takes about fifty minutes.

words.pinyin: nǐ jiā lí xuéxiào (yǒu) duō yuǎn
words.meaning: how far is your home from school

words.pinyin: wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn
words.meaning: my home is far from school

words.traditional: 走路差不多要五十分鐘
words.simplified: 走路差不多要五十分钟

text.traditional: A：那張桌子（有）多長？B：那張桌子（有）八十公分。
text.simplified: A：那张桌子（有）多长？B：那张桌子（有）八十公分。
text.pinyin: A：Nà zhāng zhuōzi (yǒu) duō cháng? B：Nà zhāng zhuōzi (yǒu) bāshí gōngfēn.
text.english: A: How long is that table? B: That table is 80 centimeters long.

text.traditional: A：你知道合歡山（有）多高嗎？B：差不多三千五百公尺。
text.simplified: A：你知道合欢山（有）多高吗？B：差不多三千五百公尺。
text.pinyin: A：Nǐ zhīdào Héhuān Shān (yǒu) duō gāo ma? B：Chàbuduō sānqiān wǔbǎi gōngchǐ.
text.english: A: Do you know how high Hehuan Mountain is? B: About 3,500 meters.

words.traditional: 你知道合歡山（有）多高嗎
words.simplified: 你知道合欢山（有）多高吗
words.pinyin: nǐ zhīdào Héhuān Shān (yǒu) duō gāo ma
words.meaning: do you know how high Hehuan Mountain is

items.question: 「多」放在形容詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在前面：多大、多長、多遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 你知道合歡山（有）高多嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 你知道合欢山（有）高多吗？

right.traditional: 你知道合歡山（有）多高嗎？
right.simplified: 你知道合欢山（有）多高吗？
right.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào Héhuān Shān (yǒu) duō gāo ma?
right.english: Do you know how high Hehuan Mountain is?

items.question: 問句的「有」一定要說嗎？
items.answer: 不一定。「有」常常省略：多大、多長、多遠。
items.wrongTraditional: 那張桌子多長有？
items.wrongSimplified: 那张桌子多长有？

right.traditional: 那張桌子（有）多長？
right.simplified: 那张桌子（有）多长？
right.pinyin: Nà zhāng zhuōzi (yǒu) duō cháng?
right.english: How long is that table?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 多 before a state word to ask about its degree: 多 + adjective/state word. 有 may appear before 多, but is often left out. For example, (有)多遠 asks how far something is.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern contains “Question Word 多+Vs (as predicate)” to inquire the degree achieved. In this pattern, “有” is frequently omitted.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Not doing something for a period of time
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how long something has not happened or will not happen: 兩天沒睡覺、半年不說中文.
grammarPages.explanation: 把時間長度放在「沒」或「不」前面，表示某個動作有多久沒發生：兩天沒睡覺、半年不說中文。句末常用「了」。
grammarPages.pattern: Time duration + 沒 / 不 + Verb (+ Object) + 了

text.traditional: 我已經兩天沒睡覺了，真累！
text.simplified: 我已经两天没睡觉了，真累！
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng liǎng tiān méi shuìjiào le, zhēn lèi!
text.english: I haven't slept for two days; I'm really tired!

text.traditional: 你想，如果山本良介半年不說中文，他還記得怎麼說嗎？
text.simplified: 你想，如果山本良介半年不说中文，他还记得怎么说吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng, rúguǒ Shānběn Liángjiè bàn nián bù shuō Zhōngwén, tā hái jìde zěnme shuō ma?
text.english: Do you think that if Yamamoto Ryosuke doesn't speak Chinese for half a year, he will still remember how to speak it?

text.traditional: A：他的房間有老鼠！B：真的嗎？他多久沒打掃了？
text.simplified: A：他的房间有老鼠！B：真的吗？他多久没打扫了？
text.pinyin: A：Tā de fángjiān yǒu lǎoshǔ! B：Zhēn de ma? Tā duōjiǔ méi dǎsǎo le?
text.english: A: There are mice in his room! B: Really? How long has it been since he cleaned?

words.meaning: there are mice in his room

items.question: 時間長度放在「沒」前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在前面：兩天沒睡覺、三個月沒掃地。
items.wrongTraditional: 我沒兩天睡覺了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我没两天睡觉了。

right.traditional: 我已經兩天沒睡覺了。
right.simplified: 我已经两天没睡觉了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng liǎng tiān méi shuìjiào le.
right.english: I haven't slept for two days.

items.question: 「多久沒打掃」問的是次數嗎？
items.answer: 不是。它問從上次打掃到現在過了多久。
items.wrongTraditional: 他多久打掃了？
items.wrongSimplified: 他多久打扫了？

right.traditional: 他多久沒打掃了？
right.simplified: 他多久没打扫了？
right.pinyin: Tā duōjiǔ méi dǎsǎo le?
right.english: How long has it been since he cleaned?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put a length of time before 沒 or 不 and the verb to say that an action has not happened, or has not been done, for that period. 沒 often pairs with 了 at the end to describe a state that continues up to now; 不 can describe a repeated or habitual absence of the action.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern, always including a negation word “不” or “沒,” indicates the time duration of a certain situation in which an action has yet to happen.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Question word + 都 / 也: all or none
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that everyone, everything or everywhere is included or excluded: 誰也不認識、哪裡都有.
grammarPages.explanation: 疑問詞（什麼、誰、哪裡、怎麼、哪國）和「都」或「也」一起用，表示全部包括或全部不包括：什麼都不想吃、誰也不認識。
grammarPages.pattern: Question word + 都 / 也 + Verb phrase

text.traditional: 錢先生哪國語言都會說。
text.simplified: 钱先生哪国语言都会说。
text.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng nǎ guó yǔyán dōu huì shuō.
text.english: Mr. Qian can speak the languages of every country.

text.traditional: 我不舒服，什麼都不想吃。
text.simplified: 我不舒服，什么都不想吃。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bù shūfu, shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī.
text.english: I don't feel well; I don't want to eat anything.

text.traditional: 我剛剛到台灣，誰也不認識。
text.simplified: 我刚刚到台湾，谁也不认识。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng dào Táiwān, shéi yě bú rènshi.
text.english: I have just arrived in Taiwan; I don't know anyone.

text.traditional: 中國菜很有名，哪裡都有中國餐廳。
text.simplified: 中国菜很有名，哪里都有中国餐厅。
text.pinyin: Zhōngguó cài hěn yǒumíng, nǎlǐ dōu yǒu Zhōngguó cāntīng.
text.english: Chinese food is famous; Chinese restaurants are everywhere.

text.traditional: 這個字很難，我怎麼寫都不對。
text.simplified: 这个字很难，我怎么写都不对。
text.pinyin: Zhège zì hěn nán, wǒ zěnme xiě dōu bú duì.
text.english: This character is hard; however I write it, it is wrong.

items.question: 「都」或「也」放在疑問詞前面嗎？
items.answer: 不。疑問詞先說，再用「都/也」：誰也不認識、哪裡都有中國餐廳。
items.wrongTraditional: 我剛剛到台灣，也誰不認識。
items.wrongSimplified: 我刚刚到台湾，也谁不认识。

right.traditional: 我剛剛到台灣，誰也不認識。
right.simplified: 我刚刚到台湾，谁也不认识。
right.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng dào Táiwān, shéi yě bú rènshi.
right.english: I have just arrived in Taiwan; I don't know anyone.

words.meaning: I have just arrived in Taiwan

items.question: 肯定句和否定句都可以用嗎？
items.answer: 可以。肯定句表示全部包括，否定句表示全部不包括。
items.wrongTraditional: 我什麼想吃都不。
items.wrongSimplified: 我什么想吃都不。

right.traditional: 我不舒服，什麼都不想吃。
right.simplified: 我不舒服，什么都不想吃。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bù shūfu, shénme dōu bù xiǎng chī.
right.english: I don't feel well; I don't want to eat anything.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In a statement, a question word such as 什麼, 誰, or 哪裡 can pair with 都 or 也 to include every possibility. In a negative statement, the same pattern excludes every possibility and means “none” or “not at all.”
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In Chinese, question words may co-occur with “都” or “也” in declarative sentences to indicate entirety. That is, in affirmative sentences, this pattern indicates total inclusion, while in negative ones, it indicates total exclusion.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something happens again: 又餓了、又要去買書.
grammarPages.explanation: 「又」表示同一個動作再次發生，或類似的情況再次出現。它常和「了」或「沒」一起用；表示想再做某事的「再」放在情態動詞後面，兩者不同。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 又 + Verb phrase

text.traditional: 他剛剛吃了一碗牛肉麵和三個包子，現在又餓了。
text.simplified: 他刚刚吃了一碗牛肉面和三个包子，现在又饿了。
text.pinyin: Tā gānggāng chī le yì wǎn niúròu miàn hé sān ge bāozi, xiànzài yòu è le.
text.english: He just ate a bowl of beef noodles and three steamed buns, and now he is hungry again.

text.traditional: 金先生上個月買的書都看完了，今天又要去買書了。
text.simplified: 金先生上个月买的书都看完了，今天又要去买书了。
text.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng shàng ge yuè mǎi de shū dōu kàn wán le, jīntiān yòu yào qù mǎi shū le.
text.english: Mr. Jin finished all the books he bought last month, and today he is going to buy books again.

text.traditional: 他去美國旅行了兩個星期以後，又去越南玩了五天。
text.simplified: 他去美国旅行了两个星期以后，又去越南玩了五天。
text.pinyin: Tā qù Měiguó lǚxíng le liǎng ge xīngqí yǐhòu, yòu qù Yuènán wán le wǔ tiān.
text.english: After traveling in the United States for two weeks, he went to Vietnam for five days.

items.question: 「又」和「再」哪裡不同？
items.answer: 「又」說已經再次發生的事，常和「了」用；「再」說想或要做第二次，常放在情態動詞後面。
items.wrongTraditional: 我想又喝一杯。
items.wrongSimplified: 我想又喝一杯。

right.traditional: 我又想喝了。
right.simplified: 我又想喝了。
right.pinyin: Wǒ yòu xiǎng hē le.
right.english: I want to drink again.

items.question: 「又」放在動詞前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在動詞前面：又餓了、又要去買書。
items.wrongTraditional: 他現在餓又了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他现在饿又了。

right.traditional: 他剛剛吃了一碗牛肉麵和三個包子，現在又餓了。
right.simplified: 他刚刚吃了一碗牛肉面和三个包子，现在又饿了。
right.pinyin: Tā gānggāng chī le yì wǎn niúròu miàn hé sān ge bāozi, xiànzài yòu è le.
right.english: He just ate a bowl of beef noodles and three steamed buns, and now he is hungry again.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 又 for a recurring action or situation, including one now intended or expected to happen again. It often pairs with 了 or 沒 and can come before a modal verb such as 要. 再 emphasizes an intended repeat action and is common in requests; it can follow a modal verb, as in the printed example 請再說一次.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “又” means the repetition of the same action or the reappearance of similar situation. “再” and “又” both mean repetition. However, “再” emphasizes the intention to repeat certain actions, so it can be used in imperative sentences and placed after modal verbs, e.g., “請再說一次” (Please say it again.) and “我想再喝一杯”. (I'd like to have another drink.) “又” is used after certain actions or showing the intention of performing the action. “又” mostly collocates with “了” or “沒” and is placed before the modal verbs. e.g., “我又說了一次” (I said that again.) and “我又想喝了” (I wanted to drink again.)

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something happened later than expected: 十一點才起來、昨天才到.
grammarPages.explanation: 「才」放在動詞前面，表示動作比預期晚發生：十一點才起來、昨天才到。
grammarPages.pattern: Time + 才 + Verb phrase

text.traditional: 我昨天太累了，所以今天早上十一點才起來。
text.simplified: 我昨天太累了，所以今天早上十一点才起来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān tài lèi le, suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshang shíyī diǎn cái qǐlái.
text.english: I was too tired yesterday, so I did not get up until eleven this morning.

text.traditional: A：你是上個月從英國到台灣的嗎？B：不是，我是昨天才到的。
text.simplified: A：你是上个月从英国到台湾的吗？B：不是，我是昨天才到的。
text.pinyin: A：Nǐ shì shàng ge yuè cóng Yīngguó dào Táiwān de ma? B：Bú shì, wǒ shì zuótiān cái dào de.
text.english: A: Did you come to Taiwan from the UK last month? B: No, I only arrived yesterday.

words.traditional: 你是上個月從英國到台灣的嗎
words.simplified: 你是上个月从英国到台湾的吗
words.pinyin: nǐ shì shàng ge yuè cóng Yīngguó dào Táiwān de ma
words.meaning: did you come to Taiwan from the UK last month

words.pinyin: wǒ shì zuótiān cái dào de

text.traditional: A：我們什麼時候考試？我還沒準備，怎麼辦？B：我們下個禮拜才考，你還有時間準備。
text.simplified: A：我们什么时候考试？我还没准备，怎么办？B：我们下个礼拜才考，你还有时间准备。
text.pinyin: A：Wǒmen shénme shíhou kǎoshì? Wǒ hái méi zhǔnbèi, zěnme bàn? B：Wǒmen xià ge lǐbài cái kǎo, nǐ hái yǒu shíjiān zhǔnbèi.
text.english: A: When is our exam? I haven't prepared yet; what should I do? B: Our exam is not until next week; you still have time to prepare.

words.pinyin: wǒmen xià ge lǐbài cái kǎo
words.meaning: our exam is not until next week
you still have time to prepare

items.question: 「才」表示比預期早還是晚？
items.answer: 表示比預期晚：十一點才起來、昨天才到。
items.wrongTraditional: 我昨天才十一點就起來了。
items.wrongSimplified: 我昨天才十一点就起来了。

right.traditional: 我昨天太累了，所以今天早上十一點才起來。
right.simplified: 我昨天太累了，所以今天早上十一点才起来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān tài lèi le, suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshang shíyī diǎn cái qǐlái.
right.english: I was too tired yesterday, so I did not get up until eleven this morning.

words.traditional: 所以今天早上十一點才起來
words.simplified: 所以今天早上十一点才起来
words.pinyin: suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshang shíyī diǎn cái qǐlái
words.meaning: so I did not get up until eleven this morning

items.question: 「才」放在時間前面還是後面？
items.answer: 時間在前，「才」在動詞前：十一點才起來。
items.wrongTraditional: 才我十一點起來。
items.wrongSimplified: 才我十一点起来。

right.traditional: 我們下個禮拜才考，你還有時間準備。
right.simplified: 我们下个礼拜才考，你还有时间准备。
right.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge lǐbài cái kǎo, nǐ hái yǒu shíjiān zhǔnbèi.
right.english: Our exam is not until next week; you still have time to prepare.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put 才 after the time expression and before the action to show that it happens later than expected. The speaker treats the time as late or delayed.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: “才” implies that an action happened or will happen later than expected.

items.title: Grammar 10–11 · I Want to Live in a Clean Place

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我要住在乾淨的地方

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 山本良介今天早上出門的時候，看見房間門口有一個袋子。他把袋子打開，發現裡面都是垃圾。下樓的時候，樓梯上也有垃圾。他想：「是誰把垃圾丟在這裡的？好髒啊！」他知道應該先把垃圾丟到垃圾桶，再去上課，可是他很急，不想在開學的第一天就遲到，所以什麼都沒做就去上課了。
lines.simplified: 山本良介今天早上出门的时候，看见房间门口有一个袋子。他把袋子打开，发现里面都是垃圾。下楼的时候，楼梯上也有垃圾。他想：「是谁把垃圾丢在这里的？好脏啊！」他知道应该先把垃圾丢到垃圾桶，再去上课，可是他很急，不想在开学的第一天就迟到，所以什么都没做就去上课了。
lines.pinyin: Shānběn Liángjiè jīntiān zǎoshang chūmén de shíhou, kànjiàn fángjiān ménkǒu yǒu yí ge dàizi. Tā bǎ dàizi dǎkāi, fāxiàn lǐmiàn dōu shì lèsè. Xià lóu de shíhou, lóutī shàng yě yǒu lèsè. Tā xiǎng: 「Shì shéi bǎ lèsè diū zài zhèlǐ de? Hǎo zāng a!」 Tā zhīdào yīnggāi xiān bǎ lèsè diū dào lèsè tǒng, zài qù shàngkè, kěshì tā hěn jí, bù xiǎng zài kāixué de dì yī tiān jiù chídào, suǒyǐ shénme dōu méi zuò jiù qù shàngkè le.
lines.english: When Yamamoto Ryosuke went out this morning, he saw a bag at the door of his dorm room. He opened the bag and found that there was nothing but garbage in it. When he went downstairs, there was also garbage on the stairs. "Who dumped the garbage here? It's so dirty!" he thought. He knew that he should have thrown the garbage to the trash can before attending class, but he was in a hurry because he did not want to be late on the first day of school. Therefore, he went to class without doing anything.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 中午良介回去的時候，覺得宿舍裡的空氣很不好。因為垃圾的味道很臭，而且到處都有小蟲子在飛，他就趕快把全部的垃圾都丟了。良介記得小時候媽媽告訴過他，吃完飯以後要洗碗、倒垃圾。星期六起床以後，不但要打掃房間，也得把髒衣服洗一洗。這些家事做完了以後，住在房子裡的每一個人才會覺得舒服。要是客人或是鄰居要來，也不用擔心家裡太髒。
lines.simplified: 中午良介回去的时候，觉得宿舍里的空气很不好。因为垃圾的味道很臭，而且到处都有小虫子在飞，他就赶快把全部的垃圾都丢了。良介记得小时候妈妈告诉过他，吃完饭以后要洗碗、倒垃圾。星期六起床以后，不但要打扫房间，也得把脏衣服洗一洗。这些家事做完了以后，住在房子里的每一个人才会觉得舒服。要是客人或是邻居要来，也不用担心家里太脏。
lines.pinyin: Zhōngwǔ Liángjiè huíqù de shíhou, juéde sùshè lǐ de kōngqì hěn bù hǎo. Yīnwèi lèsè de wèidào hěn chòu, érqiě dàochù dōu yǒu xiǎo chóngzi zài fēi, tā jiù gǎnkuài bǎ quánbù de lèsè dōu diū le. Liángjiè jìde xiǎoshíhou māma gàosu guò tā, chī wán fàn yǐhòu yào xǐ wǎn, dào lèsè. Xīngqíliù qǐchuáng yǐhòu, búdàn yào dǎsǎo fángjiān, yě děi bǎ zāng yīfu xǐ yī xǐ. Zhèxiē jiāshì zuò wán le yǐhòu, zhù zài fángzi lǐ de měi yí ge rén cái huì juéde shūfu. Yàoshi kèrén huòshì línjū yào lái, yě búyòng dānxīn jiā lǐ tài zāng.
lines.english: At noon, when Ryosuke went back to the dormitory, he felt that the air in the dormitory was not good. The smell of the garbage was stinky, and there were insects flying everywhere, so he immediately threw all the garbage away. Ryosuke remembered that when he was a child, his mother had told him to wash the dishes and take out the garbage after finishing a meal. After getting up on Saturday, he not only had to clean his room but also had to wash the dirty clothes. After this housework was done, everyone living in the house would feel comfortable. If a guest or a neighbor came to visit, there was no need to worry that the house was too dirty, either.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: 晚上良介吃完飯，回宿舍的時候，他看見牆上寫著「不要亂丟垃圾」，可是地上還是有一些垃圾。他想，要是每個人都覺得打掃是別人的事，不久以後，這個地方就會又髒又亂，沒有人想住了。
lines.simplified: 晚上良介吃完饭，回宿舍的时候，他看见墙上写着「不要乱丢垃圾」，可是地上还是有一些垃圾。他想，要是每个人都觉得打扫是别人的事，不久以后，这个地方就会又脏又乱，没有人想住了。
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshang Liángjiè chī wán fàn, huí sùshè de shíhou, tā kànjiàn qiáng shàng xiězhe 「Búyào luàn diū lèsè」, kěshì dìshàng háishì yǒu yìxiē lèsè. Tā xiǎng, yàoshi měi ge rén dōu juéde dǎsǎo shì biérén de shì, bùjiǔ yǐhòu, zhège dìfāng jiù huì yòu zāng yòu luàn, méiyǒu rén xiǎng zhù le.
lines.english: After eating in the evening, Ryosuke went back to the dormitory. He saw "No Littering" written on the wall. However, there was still some garbage on the ground. He thought that if everyone considers cleaning to be other people's business, this place would be dirty and messy soon after, and nobody wants to live in.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with 在 and 到
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say where something ends up: 丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上.
grammarPages.explanation: 把字句的動詞後面用「在」表示動作後東西的位置，用「到」表示動作到達的地方：丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Noun + Verb + 在 / 到 + Place

text.traditional: 孩子把髒衣服丟在浴室裡。
text.simplified: 孩子把脏衣服丢在浴室里。
text.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài yùshì lǐ.
text.english: The child threw the dirty clothes in the bathroom.

text.traditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫在信封上呢？
text.simplified: 你怎么没把地址写在信封上呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme méi bǎ dìzhǐ xiě zài xìnfēng shàng ne?
text.english: How come you didn't write the address on the envelope?

text.traditional: 我覺得把錢放在銀行比放在家裡安全得多。
text.simplified: 我觉得把钱放在银行比放在家里安全得多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde bǎ qián fàng zài yínháng bǐ fàng zài jiā lǐ ānquán de duō.
text.english: I think putting money in the bank is much safer than keeping it at home.

text.traditional: 媽媽把蛋糕拿到廚房的桌子上。
text.simplified: 妈妈把蛋糕拿到厨房的桌子上。
text.pinyin: Māma bǎ dàngāo ná dào chúfáng de zhuōzi shàng.
text.english: Mom took the cake to the kitchen table.

text.traditional: 你不可以把球踢到馬路上，太危險了。
text.simplified: 你不可以把球踢到马路上，太危险了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù kěyǐ bǎ qiú tī dào mǎlù shàng, tài wéixiǎn le.
text.english: You must not kick the ball onto the road; it's too dangerous.

text.traditional: 李小姐把生日卡片寄到男朋友家。
text.simplified: 李小姐把生日卡片寄到男朋友家。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě bǎ shēngrì kǎpiàn jì dào nánpéngyou jiā.
text.english: Miss Li mailed the birthday card to her boyfriend's home.

items.question: 地方放在「V在/到」前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在後面：丟在浴室裡、拿到桌子上。
items.wrongTraditional: 孩子把髒衣服在浴室裡丟。
items.wrongSimplified: 孩子把脏衣服在浴室里丢。

right.traditional: 孩子把髒衣服丟在浴室裡。
right.simplified: 孩子把脏衣服丢在浴室里。
right.pinyin: Háizi bǎ zāng yīfu diū zài yùshì lǐ.
right.english: The child threw the dirty clothes in the bathroom.

items.question: 地址用「寫在」還是「寫到」？
items.answer: 地址留在信封上，用「寫在」；東西送到一個地方，用「寄到」。
items.wrongTraditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫到信封上呢？
items.wrongSimplified: 你怎么没把地址写到信封上呢？

right.traditional: 你怎麼沒把地址寫在信封上呢？
right.simplified: 你怎么没把地址写在信封上呢？
right.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme méi bǎ dìzhǐ xiě zài xìnfēng shàng ne?
right.english: How come you didn't write the address on the envelope?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 把 + object + verb + 在/到 + place to say where the action leaves the object. 在 marks its resulting location; 到 marks the place it reaches. The location follows the verb and complement.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: This pattern is the combination of “S（+Neg）+把+N+V+Complement” (see the first grammar after the dialogue in this lesson) and “V在” (see the first grammar after the text in Lesson One) and “V到”. It indicates the location or place of the Object after the action is over.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what result follows only when a condition is met: 才不會覺得冷、才能寫得好看.
grammarPages.explanation: 「才」在第二個句子裡，表示前面的條件或原因成立以後，才有後面的結果。第一個句子常用「得、要、為了、因為」。
grammarPages.pattern: Condition + 才 + Result

columns.pinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu
columns.meaning: you'd better put on another layer

columns.pinyin: nǐ děi měi tiān liànxí xiě zì
columns.meaning: you have to practice writing every day

text.traditional: 他昨天是因為生病才沒來上課。
text.simplified: 他昨天是因为生病才没来上课。
text.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shì yīnwèi shēngbìng cái méi lái shàngkè.
text.english: Yesterday he missed class only because he was sick.

text.traditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不會覺得冷。
text.simplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不会觉得冷。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu, cái bú huì juéde lěng.
text.english: You'd better put on another piece of clothing so you won't feel cold.

text.traditional: 你得每天練習寫字，字才能寫得好看。
text.simplified: 你得每天练习写字，字才能写得好看。
text.pinyin: Nǐ děi měi tiān liànxí xiě zì, zì cái néng xiě de hǎokàn.
text.english: You have to practice writing every day; only then can your characters look good.

items.question: 「才」放在結果前面還是後面？
items.answer: 放在結果前面：才不會覺得冷、才能寫得好看。
items.wrongTraditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，不會才覺得冷。
items.wrongSimplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，不会才觉得冷。

right.traditional: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不會覺得冷。
right.simplified: 你最好再穿一件衣服，才不会觉得冷。
right.pinyin: Nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu, cái bú huì juéde lěng.
right.english: You'd better put on another piece of clothing so you won't feel cold.

words.pinyin: nǐ zuìhǎo zài chuān yí jiàn yīfu
words.meaning: you'd better put on another layer

items.question: 第一個句子常用哪些詞？
items.answer: 常用「得、要、為了、因為」：你得先買票、因為生病才沒來。
items.wrongTraditional: 你生病因為才沒來上課。
items.wrongSimplified: 你生病因为才没来上课。

right.traditional: 他昨天是因為生病才沒來上課。
right.simplified: 他昨天是因为生病才没来上课。
right.pinyin: Tā zuótiān shì yīnwèi shēngbìng cái méi lái shàngkè.
right.english: Yesterday he missed class only because he was sick.

words.meaning: it was because he was sick

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Use 才 in the result clause to show that the result happens only when the earlier condition is met. Put the condition first and 才 before the resulting action or state. The first clause may include 得, 要, 為了, or 因為.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: In this pattern, the adverb “才” in the second clause is used to show consequences when the conditions and causes in the first clause are fulfilled. Thus, “得 (have to)”, “要 (need to)”, “為了 (in order to)”, and “因為 (because)” are often used in the first clause of this pattern.

items.title: Grammar 1–7 · I Want to Rent a House

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的門口，房東王太太剛好出來了。）
lines.simplified: （良介去看房子，他和可欣到了公寓的门口，房东王太太刚好出来了。）
lines.pinyin: （Liángjiè qù kàn fángzi, tā hé Kěxīn dào le gōngyù de ménkǒu, fángdōng Wáng tàitai gānghǎo chūlái le.）
lines.english: (Ryosuke goes to view an apartment. When he and Kexin arrive at the entrance of the building, the landlady, Mrs. Wang, happens to come out.)

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 王太太，您好。我是陳可欣。這位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他來看房子。
lines.simplified: 王太太，您好。我是陈可欣。这位是我的朋友山本良介，我陪他来看房子。
lines.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, nín hǎo. Wǒ shì Chén Kěxīn. Zhè wèi shì wǒ de péngyou Shānběn Liángjiè, wǒ péi tā lái kàn fángzi.
lines.english: Mrs. Wang, hello. I'm Kexin Chen. This is my friend Ryosuke Yamamoto. I'm accompanying him to look at the apartment.

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 你們好！這棟公寓一共有六層，我要出租的房子在四樓，我們一起上去看看吧！
lines.simplified: 你们好！这栋公寓一共有六层，我要出租的房子在四楼，我们一起上去看看吧！
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen hǎo! Zhè dòng gōngyù yígòng yǒu liù céng, wǒ yào chūzū de fángzi zài sì lóu, wǒmen yìqǐ shàngqù kànkan ba!
lines.english: Hello! This apartment building has six floors in total. The apartment I want to rent out is on the fourth floor. Let's go up and take a look!

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 好的。對了，請問有家具嗎？
lines.simplified: 好的。对了，请问有家具吗？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Duì le, qǐngwèn yǒu jiājù ma?
lines.english: OK. By the way, may I ask if there is furniture?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 有。臥室有床、書桌、椅子、沙發，還有一個大衣櫃，可以掛很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣機都是新的。
lines.simplified: 有。卧室有床、书桌、椅子、沙发，还有一个大衣柜，可以挂很多衣服，而且冰箱、洗衣机都是新的。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu. Wòshì yǒu chuáng, shūzhuō, yǐzi, shāfā, hái yǒu yí ge dà yīguì, kěyǐ guà hěn duō yīfu, érqiě bīngxiāng, xǐyījī dōu shì xīn de.
lines.english: Yes. The bedroom has a bed, a desk, a chair and a sofa, and there is also a large closet for hanging many clothes. The refrigerator and washing machine are both new.

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.traditional: （三人到了四樓）
lines.simplified: （三人到了四楼）
lines.pinyin: （Sān rén dào le sì lóu.）
lines.english: (The three of them reach the fourth floor.)

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 請進！我給你們介紹介紹。這是客廳，右邊是廚房，臥室和浴室在那邊。
lines.simplified: 请进！我给你们介绍介绍。这是客厅，右边是厨房，卧室和浴室在那边。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng jìn! Wǒ gěi nǐmen jièshào jièshào. Zhè shì kètīng, yòubiān shì chúfáng, wòshì hé yùshì zài nàbiān.
lines.english: Please come in! Let me show you around. This is the living room; the kitchen is on the right; the bedroom and bathroom are over there.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 房間看起來很好！請問附近有超級市場嗎？
lines.simplified: 房间看起来很好！请问附近有超级市场吗？
lines.pinyin: Fángjiān kànqǐlái hěn hǎo! Qǐngwèn fùjìn yǒu chāojí shìchǎng ma?
lines.english: The room looks great! May I ask if there is a supermarket nearby?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 有啊！從這裡出去，走五分鐘就有超市和便利商店了。
lines.simplified: 有啊！从这里出去，走五分钟就有超市和便利商店了。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu a! Cóng zhèlǐ chūqù, zǒu wǔ fēnzhōng jiù yǒu chāoshì hé biànlì shāngdiàn le.
lines.english: Yes! Go out from here, and a five-minute walk brings you to a supermarket and a convenience store.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這裡有網路嗎？
lines.simplified: 这里有网路吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèlǐ yǒu wǎnglù ma?
lines.english: Is there internet here?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 沒有，我可以替你裝網路，可是每個月的費用要自己付。
lines.simplified: 没有，我可以替你装网路，可是每个月的费用要自己付。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ kěyǐ tì nǐ zhuāng wǎnglù, kěshì měi ge yuè de fèiyòng yào zìjǐ fù.
lines.english: No. I can set up the internet for you, but you have to pay the monthly fee yourself.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 聽起來不錯。請問房租一個月多少錢？
lines.simplified: 听起来不错。请问房租一个月多少钱？
lines.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái búcuò. Qǐngwèn fángzū yí ge yuè duōshao qián?
lines.english: That sounds good. May I ask how much the rent is per month?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 一個月一萬五千塊，不包括水費、電費，還要兩個月的押金。
lines.simplified: 一个月一万五千块，不包括水费、电费，还要两个月的押金。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè yí wàn wǔqiān kuài, bù bāokuò shuǐfèi, diànfèi, hái yào liǎng ge yuè de yājīn.
lines.english: It's $15,000 a month, not including water and electricity, and a two-month deposit is also required.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 好，我先跟我朋友討論一下，請您等一會兒。
lines.simplified: 好，我先跟我朋友讨论一下，请您等一会儿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ xiān gēn wǒ péngyou tǎolùn yíxià, qǐng nín děng yìhuǐr.
lines.english: OK. Let me discuss it with my friend first. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 你覺得這裡怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你觉得这里怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ juéde zhèlǐ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: What do you think of this place?

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 這邊的環境不錯，可是付了房租以後，我的獎學金就只剩一萬塊了。
lines.simplified: 这边的环境不错，可是付了房租以后，我的奖学金就只剩一万块了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèbiān de huánjìng búcuò, kěshì fù le fángzū yǐhòu, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn jiù zhǐ shèng yí wàn kuài le.
lines.english: The environment here is nice, but after paying the rent, I'll have only $10,000 of my scholarship left.

lines.speaker: 可欣
lines.traditional: 這樣的房子都不便宜。你問問王太太，房租能不能便宜一點兒。
lines.simplified: 这样的房子都不便宜。你问问王太太，房租能不能便宜一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng de fángzi dōu bù piányi. Nǐ wènwen Wáng tàitai, fángzū néng bu néng piányi yìdiǎnr.
lines.english: Apartments like this are all expensive. Ask Mrs. Wang if the rent can be a little cheaper.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 王太太，這個公寓我很滿意，可是房租有一點兒貴，可以便宜一點兒嗎？
lines.simplified: 王太太，这个公寓我很满意，可是房租有一点儿贵，可以便宜一点儿吗？
lines.pinyin: Wáng tàitai, zhège gōngyù wǒ hěn mǎnyì, kěshì fángzū yǒu yìdiǎnr guì, kěyǐ piányi yìdiǎnr ma?
lines.english: Mrs. Wang, I'm very satisfied with this apartment, but the rent is a little expensive. Can it be a little cheaper?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 我想想……你是留學生吧？我兒子也去法國留學了，我知道外國人找房子不太容易。
lines.simplified: 我想想……你是留学生吧？我儿子也去法国留学了，我知道外国人找房子不太容易。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎngxiang…… Nǐ shì liúxuéshēng ba? Wǒ érzi yě qù Fǎguó liúxué le, wǒ zhīdào wàiguórén zhǎo fángzi bú tài róngyì.
lines.english: Let me think... You're an international student, right? My son also went to study in France. I know it's not easy for foreigners to find an apartment.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 對啊！我看了好幾個地方，有的環境很好，可是房租太貴；有些房東一看我是外國人，就不願意租給我了。
lines.simplified: 对啊！我看了好几个地方，有的环境很好，可是房租太贵；有些房东一看我是外国人，就不愿意租给我了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a! Wǒ kàn le hǎo jǐ ge dìfāng, yǒude huánjìng hěn hǎo, kěshì fángzū tài guì; yǒuxiē fángdōng yí kàn wǒ shì wàiguórén, jiù bú yuànyì zū gěi wǒ le.
lines.english: That's right! I've looked at several places. Some have a nice environment but the rent is too high; some landlords, as soon as they see that I'm a foreigner, are unwilling to rent to me.

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 好吧！你那麼喜歡，那就一個月一萬兩千塊。
lines.simplified: 好吧！你那么喜欢，那就一个月一万两千块。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba! Nǐ nàme xǐhuan, nà jiù yí ge yuè yí wàn liǎngqiān kuài.
lines.english: All right! Since you like it so much, I'll make it $12,000 a month.

lines.speaker: 良介
lines.traditional: 太好了！謝謝您，我決定租半年。下個星期一可以簽約嗎？
lines.simplified: 太好了！谢谢您，我决定租半年。下个星期一可以签约吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Xièxie nín, wǒ juédìng zū bàn nián. Xià ge xīngqíyī kěyǐ qiānyuē ma?
lines.english: Great! Thank you. I've decided to rent it for half a year. Can we sign the lease next Monday?

lines.speaker: 王太太
lines.traditional: 可以，你過來簽約的時候請帶護照、房租和兩個月的押金。簽約以後會給你鑰匙，你就可以搬進來了。
lines.simplified: 可以，你过来签约的时候请带护照、房租和两个月的押金。签约以后会给你钥匙，你就可以搬进来了。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ, nǐ guòlái qiānyuē de shíhou qǐng dài hùzhào, fángzū hé liǎng ge yuè de yājīn. Qiānyuē yǐhòu huì gěi nǐ yàoshi, nǐ jiù kěyǐ bān jìnlái le.
lines.english: Yes. When you come to sign the lease, please bring your passport, the rent and a two-month deposit. After you sign, I'll give you the keys and you can move in.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether movement comes toward you or goes away: come up, go down, come in, go out.
grammarPages.explanation: 「來」表示動作朝向說話的人，「去」表示動作離開說話的人。方向動詞和「來／去」結合成「上來、上去、下來、下去」等，說明動作的方向。
grammarPages.pattern: Directional verb + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上來。
text.simplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上来。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èr lóu, qǐng shànglái.
text.english: My room is on the second floor. Please come up.

text.traditional: 爸爸有事找你，你趕快過去。
text.simplified: 爸爸有事找你，你赶快过去。
text.pinyin: Bàba yǒu shì zhǎo nǐ, nǐ gǎnkuài guòqù.
text.english: Dad is looking for you. Hurry over.

text.traditional: 他出去一會兒，五分鐘以後就回來。
text.simplified: 他出去一会儿，五分钟以后就回来。
text.pinyin: Tā chūqù yìhuǐr, wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu jiù huílái.
text.english: He went out for a while; he will be back in five minutes.

items.question: You are upstairs; your friend is downstairs. Do you say 請上來 or 請上去?
items.answer: 說話的人在樓上，用「上來」：請上來。
items.wrongTraditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上去。
items.wrongSimplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上去。

right.traditional: 我的房間在二樓，請上來。
right.simplified: 我的房间在二楼，请上来。
right.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān zài èr lóu, qǐng shànglái.
right.english: My room is on the second floor. Please come up.

items.question: Can 起來 take 去 as its partner?
items.answer: 不行。「起來」是固定的說法，表示「up」，沒有「起去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 他站起去了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他站起去了。

right.traditional: 他站起來了。
right.simplified: 他站起来了。
right.pinyin: Tā zhàn qǐlái le.
right.english: He stood up.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: A direction word combines with 來 or 去 to show movement toward or away from the speaker: Direction + 來/去, as in 上來 or 出去. 來 points toward the speaker; 去 points away.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleTraditional: motion verb + directional verb + 來/去
grammarPages.titleSimplified: motion verb + directional verb + 来/去
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Motion verb + directional verb + 來 / 去
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how someone or something moves: walk out, bring it back, carry it over.
grammarPages.explanation: 動作動詞（走、跑、帶、放、拿、搬、站）後面接方向動詞和「來／去」，說明人或東西往哪個方向移動。方向動詞有「上來/上去、下來/下去、進來/進去、出來/出去、回來/回去、過來/過去」；「拿、搬、站」也可以接「起來」。
grammarPages.pattern: Motion verb + directional verb + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面走出來了。
text.simplified: 爸爸从卧室里面走出来了。
text.pinyin: Bàba cóng wòshì lǐmiàn zǒu chūlái le.
text.english: Dad walked out of the bedroom.

text.traditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回去嗎？
text.simplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回去吗？
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē méi chīwán de miànbāo, wǒ kěyǐ dài huíqù ma?
text.english: Can I take these unfinished pieces of bread back with me?

text.traditional: 這部電腦很重，我們一起搬過去吧。
text.simplified: 这部电脑很重，我们一起搬过去吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo hěn zhòng, wǒmen yìqǐ bān guòqù ba.
text.english: This computer is heavy. Let's carry it over together.

items.question: A friend is taking the leftover bread to his own home. Do you say 帶回去 or 帶回來?
items.answer: 東西離開說話的人，用「回去」：帶回去。
items.wrongTraditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回來嗎？
items.wrongSimplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回来吗？

right.traditional: 這些沒吃完的麵包，我可以帶回去嗎？
right.simplified: 这些没吃完的面包，我可以带回去吗？
right.pinyin: Zhèxiē méi chīwán de miànbāo, wǒ kěyǐ dài huíqù ma?
right.english: Can I take these unfinished pieces of bread back with me?

items.question: Do you say 走出來 or 出來走?
items.answer: 先說動作動詞「走」，再說方向「出來」：走出來。
items.wrongTraditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面出來走。
items.wrongSimplified: 爸爸从卧室里面出来走。

right.traditional: 爸爸從臥室裡面走出來了。
right.simplified: 爸爸从卧室里面走出来了。
right.pinyin: Bàba cóng wòshì lǐmiàn zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: Dad walked out of the bedroom.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Put a motion verb before a direction compound to describe how something moves toward or away from the speaker: Motion verb + Direction + 來/去. The book uses motion verbs such as 走, 跑, 帶, 放, 拿, 搬, and 站.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleTraditional: motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去
grammarPages.titleSimplified: motion verb + directional verb + location + 来/去
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Motion verb + directional verb + place + 來 / 去
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a place to a movement: put it into the closet, take the books back to Japan.
grammarPages.explanation: 動作動詞和方向動詞後面可以再帶地方，最後用「來／去」表示方向：放進衣櫃裡去、帶回日本去。
grammarPages.pattern: Motion verb + directional verb + location + 來 / 去

text.traditional: 那些髒衣服不要放進衣櫃裡去。
text.simplified: 那些脏衣服不要放进衣柜里去。
text.pinyin: Nàxiē zāng yīfu búyào fàng jìn yīguì lǐ qù.
text.english: Don't put those dirty clothes into the closet.

text.traditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回日本去。
text.simplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回日本去。
text.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén shū, Shānběn Liángjiè dōu yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
text.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto will take all these Chinese books back to Japan.

text.traditional: 路上的車很多，那個人從對面跑過街來，真危險！
text.simplified: 路上的车很多，那个人从对面跑过街来，真危险！
text.pinyin: Lùshang de chē hěn duō, nàge rén cóng duìmiàn pǎo guò jiē lái, zhēn wéixiǎn!
text.english: There are many cars on the road. That person ran across the street from the opposite side. How dangerous!

items.question: Where does the place go in 放進衣櫃裡去?
items.answer: 地方放在方向動詞後面：「放進衣櫃裡去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 那些髒衣服不要放衣櫃裡進去。
items.wrongSimplified: 那些脏衣服不要放衣柜里进去。

right.traditional: 那些髒衣服不要放進衣櫃裡去。
right.simplified: 那些脏衣服不要放进衣柜里去。
right.pinyin: Nàxiē zāng yīfu búyào fàng jìn yīguì lǐ qù.
right.english: Don't put those dirty clothes into the closet.

items.question: Is it 帶回日本去 or 帶回去日本?
items.answer: 地方放在「來／去」前面：「帶回日本去」。
items.wrongTraditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回去日本。
items.wrongSimplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回去日本。

right.traditional: 這些中文書，山本良介都要帶回日本去。
right.simplified: 这些中文书，山本良介都要带回日本去。
right.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén shū, Shānběn Liángjiè dōu yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
right.english: Ryosuke Yamamoto will take all these Chinese books back to Japan.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: After the motion verb and direction, add the destination before 來 or 去: Motion verb + Direction + Place + 來/去. This tells both the path and where the movement ends.
grammarPages.sourceExplanationEnglish: A directional compound describes the direction of the action. The structures include: (1) directional verb + 來/去, (2) motion verb + directional verb + 來/去, (3) motion verb + directional verb + location + 來/去, (4) combined with 把 construction to indicate the Subject moves the Object to another location: S + 把 + O + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來/去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: I Want to Rent a House
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The 把 construction with directional verbs
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 把 to move something to a place: bring the desk over, take the clothes upstairs.
grammarPages.explanation: 用「把」把要移動的東西放在前面，後面接動作動詞、方向動詞和「來／去」，也可以加上地方：把書桌搬過來、把衣服拿上樓去。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + Object + motion verb + directional verb + (location) + 來 / 去

columns.meaning: take out of the washing machine

text.traditional: 請你把那張書桌搬過來。
text.simplified: 请你把那张书桌搬过来。
text.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ nà zhāng shūzhuō bān guòlái.
